deviations_from_E2_spec: B2 stack: lip 1.7 / window edge R0.7 (E2: 1.5 / R1.0) - keeps every lip wall >= 1.2 (min 1.205); glass front y -31.0 (E2 -31.2)

A1/B2 depth: the official side view dimensions 7.50 to the PCB BACK and 11.50 to the STANDOFF ENDS -> mounting plane (standoff ends = bezel post faces = bar front face) at y -19.5, i.e. 11.5 behind the glass front (E2 text: 7.5 -> -23.7); 2x16 header modelled 5.0 tall = 12.5 behind the glass front, y -18.5 (E2: 11.5 -> -19.7); keep-out to 11.5 over the PCB + header zone to 12.5
A1: PCB modelled 78.0 x 54.6 (measured on the drawing: 72 + 2 x 3.0, 48.5 + 2 x 3.05; E2: 'about 79.5 x 55')

B2 carrier: bars 3.0 thick on 4 bezel POSTS D5.86 at (+-21, +-33.65) in the top / bottom ring; screws M2x5 into the standoffs (E2: M2x4; 2.0 thread engagement behind the 3.0 bar) and M2x6 into the inserts

E2f (user option 1, replaces E2 C2): the servo lead goes DOWN into the torso, not up into the head.  The MG90S is MODIFIED (original cable unsoldered, 3 x AWG30 silicone D <= 0.8 soldered to the pads, led out through a 2 x 2 notch filed into the FRONT long edge of the bottom cover 12.4 from the end face of the original cable) -> no lead nub, no knuckle-top slot, no foam plug, no head floor slot, no vault, no cable bridge, no servo lead in the head; servo connected in the torso

E2f groove (servo_wire_groove, FRONT neck half): x 13.15..14.55 (= +X end of the pocket), y -6.75..-3.75 design = -6.70..-3.70 closed (3.0 wide), from the neck bottom up to z 11.6.  Widened from the orchestrator's -6.2..-3.75 (2.45): 3 x D0.8 in a row need 2.4 + 0.3 after the 0.15 print shrink per wall (same rule as the head-wire passages)
E2f: +X pocket-wall foam pads narrowed to |y| 2.3..3.5 (were 2.4..5.8): they sit between the head-wire chamber and the groove
C3 cap: open knuckle bore r6.65 + cap plug (2 cheeks r6.3) instead of only a deeper arm slot; blind cap end wall 1.0 (allowed by E2)

C3 lug: concave web blend R4 and end-face round R3 (E1: R3 / R2) - the barrel must pass the collar slot corner R3.25; web half width 8.25 (E1: 8.0 = tenon) so the web covers the 0.1 clearance strip of the floor slot (E9: screw shank visible, 0.02 mm2)
C1/E5: far case end -> spline axis above 17.06 (drawing max 17.1) needs 0.05 filed off the far case end (assembly text)
C1: the longer pocket moved the hollow pin to x 13.4..18.5 (length 5.1): glued seat 2.6 long (round 5: 3.2)
neck: 4th screw = oblique M2x12 (round 5: M2x14); head-wire passage = slot 1.6 x 4.0 in the +X lug / tenon
E1 6.2 torso rim R1.0: not applied to the ILLUSTRATIVE torso of this builder when OCC refuses the fillet (see R5.collar_ring.torso_rim_round_R)

E4_raycast_walls.method: tessellation tol 0.01, 15000 area-weighted samples, ray along -normal, wall = first hit with opposite normal (dot < -0.7), rays > 3 mm ignored (round-5 rule)

E5_servo_range.servo_wires_room_rule: 3 x D0.8 in one layer between the bottom cover and the groove end: >= 0.8 + 0.3 after 0.15 print shrink

shaft_height_note.text: the E5 length variants keep the spline ON the hinge axis with the far end on / above the floor; the drawing allows far end -> spline axis 16.5..17.1: 16.5..16.9 hangs on the turret bore (<= 0.15 low, case up to 0.25 above the floor), > 17.06 would need the far case end filed (assembly text)

E6_horn_range.note: dx = axial position of the servo: -0.05 = gear face on the datum wall, +0.15 = drifted off the datum

E10_servo_wires.model: 3 x AWG30 silicone D <= 0.8 (brown / red / orange) modelled as ONE tube r 0.6 on the group centre line, bend R 1.0

inside_the_neck.note: 0.02 to the servo = the tube starts on the bottom-cover notch (wire exit); 0.1 to the groove walls (tube r 0.6 in the 1.4 wide groove)

torso_illustrative.note: the tube ends 3.0 below the neck bottom inside the torso well; the real wires continue to the torso controller (torso electronics are designed with the torso; slack for the 20 mm lift)

reference_volumes.note: OCC GProp is off by up to 3 % on the periodic lofts -> mesh volumes are the reference

2_seam_step_72pts.method: 72 polar rays (every 5 deg) in the planes y -26.6/-26.4/-26.2 (bezel) and -25.8/-25.6/-25.4 (shell), outermost hit radius, quadratic extrapolation of both exterior surfaces to the seam plane y=-26
2_seam_step_72pts.v_seam_nominal: chamfer 0.12 x 45 deg on both edges -> V 0.24 wide x 0.12 deep

rabbet_floor_probe.note: mid-ledge probes all hit the floor plane y=-25.0; 0.15 inside the inner skin nothing is hit before the magnet-boss front faces (y=-25.0, 6 places) / the cavity -> no ridge, no sliver

keepout.definition: PCB footprint 78.0 x 54.6 from the PCB back (7.50) to the standoff-end plane (11.50) minus the four 5.5 x 5.5 corner zones (standoff + bar tab), plus the header zone (41.9 x 6.2) up to 12.50

4_E8_magnets.bezel_pocket_floor_to_front_surfaces: included above (air = everything outside the resin in front of the back face)

hold_force_N.model: charge model, N35 Br 1.17 T (lower limit), D4 x 2 discs

5_E4_walls.method: round-5 rule (rc.py): area-weighted random surface samples, ray along -normal, wall = first hit with an opposite normal (dot < -0.7) within 3 mm

7_module_through_opening.method: every solid of the front module that reaches behind y=-27.5 (bezel rear with spigot + posts, LCD, PCB, standoffs, header, USB-C, components, bars, screws, inserts, bezel magnets) is translated along -Y in 22 steps (0.1..12 mm) and intersected with the shell (y -27..-10, incl. magnet bosses and pads) and the shell magnets

8_tool_path_cross_screws.tool: D4 shank along Y from the front opening (bezel module removed) to the head top y=-12.3, axis z=32.5, x = +-18.3 / +-22.3
8_tool_path_cross_screws.note: overlap_other_cross_screws = the D4 shank over the neighbouring head (axes 4.0 apart, dk 3.8): the shank stops at the head top plane, value must be 0

11_visible_through_window.method: orthographic z-buffer (0.2 mm/px) from 45 directions (az +-70, el +-50); only the pixels whose ray passes through the window opening (90 x 58.6 R4.8 at y=-33) are counted; area (mm2) of the first-hit part per view

exterior.front_round: 9 deep x 7.5 inset, equal in x and z

carrier.screws: 4 x M2x5 (standoffs) + 4 x M2x6 (inserts), ISO 7380-1 dk 3.8 k 1.3

T_tilt_vs_lift.rule: SIMPLE RULE (assembly text): tilt only when the neck is fully extended (lift 0); before retracting return to 0 deg. OPTIONAL table: between two listed lifts use the value of the MORE RETRACTED one (no interpolation)
T_tilt_vs_lift.method: OCC minimum distance of the head exterior (bottom 20 mm), usko_kryt and usko_lozisko to golier_kotuc, golier_prstenec and the torso top; a mesh-vertex pre-test rejects poses that are certainly closer than 0.2 to the flat collar top

V_E9_visibility.method: orthographic z-buffer of ALL registry parts + torso (first hit per pixel). (a) whole robot: 0.25 mm/px, 30 views (az -90,-60,-40,-20,0,20,40,60,90,180 x el -20 (from below), 0 (eye height), 35 (3/4 above)); (b) hinge window |x| <= 25, |y| <= 14, axis +-12: 0.05 mm/px, 38 views (round-5 set + az +-60 / 120 / 240).  Poses: rest, extended 0, +40, -40
